title: Knowing your customer and the use case before opening up the model

videos.script: Tarefa wants other companies to build on its assistant, through an API. Each company gets a key, and Tarefa answers for every request made with it. {{title}} So before the key come three questions. Who is this company? What will it use the model for? And how much should it be trusted with on the first day? {{questions}} The lab checks a CNPJ's arithmetic, and its status in a registry the course wrote. {{cnpj}} Then it reads the declared use case against a policy. Some uses are fine. Some need a person to look. Some are refused. {{policy}} One company calls its use case marketing. Its own description asks for five-star reviews. {{reviews}} A company that is accepted starts small and earns more. And what it declared is checked against what it does. {{tiers}} A bakery answers its customers for two weeks. In the third, most of its requests are writing product reviews. {{drift}}
